title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Is Hiding the Dragon? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg has the dragon inside? 🐉 Pick your egg and find out! Like and subscribe for a new guessing game every day!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #BrainTeaser

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON!
Is it the blue egg, the red egg, or the golden egg? Pick your answer NOW!
The blue egg cracks open… and out pops a silly rubber duck! Wrong!
The red egg cracks open… and it's just a bunch of glitter! Not a dragon!
The GOLDEN egg shakes… it glows… and out comes a tiny baby dragon! You got it!
Did you pick gold? Nice work! Come back tomorrow for Level 2!
